crossRefs.note: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
“You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify…
Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

parallels.note: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce, and divorce her?”

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”
translations.bsb: “What did Moses command you?” He replied.
translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
translations.asv: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
